verdict.rationale: Morph officially documents building with existing SDKs: point any OpenAI SDK at its base URL, use the Anthropic Messages API natively at /v1/messages, and connect OpenAI clients to dedicated endpoints. Its docs also organize capabilities under an /sdk/components section. Hands-on community use via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint corroborates this. However, the evidence never shows a first-party, Morph-branded SDK package with language bindings, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate one. missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-party Morph SDK (named packages and languages), SDK reference docs for Morph-specific tools like Fast Apply, Compact and Reflexes, and independent corroboration of such an SDK.
